svg.aria-label: PS5 DualSense controller with each control's function written beside it: L1 hold to move; D-pad left, right, away, toward; left stick up and down; right stick yaw; square and circle pitch; triangle and cross roll; R1 turbo; L1 + L2 + R2 held one second to home.
svg.text: L1 — top, front button. Release = stop
R1 — top, front button. Operator only
HOME: hold L1 + L2 + R2 for 1 s, then release L1 and press it again to drive
Photo: Chris Woodrich, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons; annotations added
